items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I wrote some stuff for Randolph

ctx.x: And you guys just sounded all very good together. How did you -- the only other time when you worked for anybody else for any length of time was with Red Norvet, and that was the second time I guess I heard you play, with Tal Farlow Tal Farlow and the trio. And I remember you -- it's the first time I remember a bass player -- it's the first time I remember a bass player really dominating a band. I mean, you really caught my ear, listening to that band. The things you were playing was so strong and so full of…
It was very hard to play that with Red, he got such a stiff beat Red Norvo, and Tal man, because -- I wrote some stuff for Randolph, (inaudible) didn't read at all.
